sloka: तं मन्ये राघवं वीरं नारायणमनामयम्।तद्भयाद्धि पुरी लङ्का पिहितद्वारतोरणा ।। ६.७२.११ ।।
transliteration: taṁ manye rāghavaṁ vīraṁ nārāyaṇamanāmayam।tadbhayāddhi purī laṅkā pihitadvāratoraṇā ।। 6.72.11 ।।

translations.english: "This city and even the Ashoka grove where Sita is kept secretly to be guarded by being vigilant on all sides."
